## Assignement 2

**Goal** Create 1 (or 2) plots that you give to the data owner showing some characteristics of the data.

Think about:

  - Readability
  - Usefulness to the owner
  - Scalability (what if we had 100 cows)
  - Color scale/axis/fonts
  
**Deliverables**

  1. The plot you created
  2. Some sentences where you tell us why your plot should win
  
## Some advises

- Keep track of time so that you manage to deliver!!
- USE AI, even if you are a Python expert!
- Maybe you can work in parallel and then agree on the final product.
